mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_seats ( id, event_id, seat_id, price, permanent_status ) SELECT ( substr(source_hash.value, 1, 8) || '-' || substr(source_hash.value, 9, 4) || '-' || substr(source_hash.value, 13, 4) || '-' || substr(source_hash.value, 17, 4) || '-' || substr(source_hash.value, 21, 12) )::uuid, e.id, seat.id, event_section.price, CASE WHEN event_section.sales_enabled THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'BLOCKED' END FROM events e JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.venue_id = e.venue_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.section_id = venue_section.id JOIN event_sections event_section ON event_section.event_id = e.id AND event_section.venue_section_id = venue_section.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT md5(e.id::text || ':' || seat.id::text) AS value ) source_hash WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.status = 'DRAFT' ON CONFLICT (event_id, seat_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.venue_id = e.venue_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.section_id = venue_section.id WHERE e.id = #{eventId}
